summary: Tenon Medical filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, announcing early repayment of its original issue discount senior convertible promissory notes, issued March 11, 2026 with roughly $5.16 million aggregate principal, ahead of a September 11, 2026 maturity. The company said the move strengthens the balance sheet and removes potential discounted conversion into common stock. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms apply; no acquisition, tender, or restructuring is involved. Watch for updated cash position and any future financing needs, as extinguishing conversion overhang reduces dilution risk but consumes liquidity.
